items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: Sylvester Cap and I, we used to walk out to, like, from here to Claiborne Street.

ctx.x: Oh, I wish I could have been a part of some of those days. Yes. I came up in the wrong generation. I'd like to...

I was saying the other day, I wish I had, uh, some of the, uh, and I like, used to get so much good fish over there. Now, this water began to, you know, gather in this and do this and do that. And you can't get all that now. The crabs, you can't get that. The shrimp, you can't get all that. And, uh, Sylvester Cap and I, we used to walk out to, like, from here to Claiborne Street. In between, they'd have that, uh, they'd have the, what you call it? Uh, they'd have the, the sand beds. The what? Sand beds, they used…
